name: coneflower

purpose.why: Rebuilt on Evan's request (2026-10-22) to replace the Ranch tile's original model with a crafted one, keeping its game role.
purpose.audience: children building and playing in a miniature ranch
purpose.style: normal (upgrade: the same asset, built better)

brief.prompt: a clump of purple coneflowers with drooping pink petals and orange-brown cones

concept.tool: Midjourney web app (midjourney.com/imagine), driven in Evan's signed-in Chrome by Claude through the Claude in Chrome extension, one job at a time, text prompts only (no image reference)

hero.prompt: a clump of purple coneflowers with drooping pink petals and orange-brown cones, stylized 3D game asset, low-poly diorama style, flat painted colors, soft studio lighting, plain warm cream background, centered, full object visible, no text --ar 1:1
hero.pick_reason: full clump with drooping pink petals and orange-brown cones, whole plant in frame

construction.by: modeler agent, directed by the art director (Claude)

rounds.change: First build: 13 blooms from the hero table, 9 bent petals, 6-sided cones, 60 base leaves, small core. 1.2k tris, over budget.
Bloom scale x1.2, wider petals and cones, 8 petals, 5-sided cones, 3-segment stems, taller base tuft; down to 991 tris.
Bloom scale 1.3, wider petal tips, 2 stem leaves higher up, wider core, low leaves splayed flat.
Vase-shaped tuft: low leaves less flat, crown narrower at the ground, leaves up to 0.38.
Bigger stem leaves, less outward bloom tilt; bloom scale / seed sweep (1.42, seed 7 best at 0.736).
Looked at it: 1.42 blooms crowded and the core read as a pot. Back to 1.32, slimmer petals, smaller core.
Core removed, 60 wider base leaves biased low; low leaves splay a little flatter.
Seed sweep (1, 3, 11, 13): seed 11 best; trimmed base leaves 60 -> 51 to hit 999 tris; final 768 px / 48 samples.

what_was_done: Scored on the hero alone (no turnaround). make_views.py keys the hero against its cream backdrop and drops the ochre cast shadow on the lower left (G/R < 0.82 or light tan in that zone, plus the thin dark tail on the ground line).
hero_check.py renders front-on from 6 deg up (harness lens). A yaw/elevation grid (yaw -20..20, elev 0..15) moved the IoU by under 0.01, so the AD's 'a few degrees above, front-on' was kept.

13 blooms placed from the hero (cone-top height and skirt width measured per bloom; tallest top centre and top right, three low at the front). Each is a 5-sided faceted dome cone (Flower_Seed_Orange, 15 tris) over 8 pink petal strips (Flower_Petal_Pink), each bent once so it droops 38-52 deg then a further 14 deg at the tip: a shuttlecock skirt. Blooms nod slightly towards the camera and out from the axis.

13 thin 3-sided stems (Stem_Green), each a quadratic curve that rises near the axis and leans out to its bloom, so the outer ones curve out like the hero's. Two narrow lance leaves per stem at 30-70 % of its height.

51 long narrow pointed leaf cards (folded, 2 tris each; Leaf_Green and 35 % Leaf_Dark) rising from a 7-11 cm crown up to 0.42 of the height, biased low, angled 20-75 deg up so the low ones splay out and the upper ones stand up: a vase-shaped tuft.
999 triangles (budget 1k), 5 meshes, one flat material each, double-sided cards. Height 0.744 m (same as the old GF-679), 0.63 x 0.43 m in plan. to_game.py coneflower ran cleanly.
construction.creative_additions: Each petal is bent once so the skirt droops more at the tips, and blooms nod slightly towards the viewer so the orange cones read from the tile's high camera.

geometry.up: Z (Blender source); Y in GLB and game
geometry.origin: centre of the footprint, on the ground

good: Hero silhouette IoU 0.729 at 768 px: the flaring crown of nodding blooms over a narrow leafy tuft matches the hero's shape.
Reads as echinacea at a glance: raised orange cones over drooping pink skirts, held on visible thin stems at staggered heights.
Two-thirds of the triangles go to blooms and stems, as asked.
off: The crown is 0.63 m wide (the hero's flare), wider than the old model's 0.41 m; the ground footprint (leaf tuft) is about 0.43 m front to back. Height is unchanged.
The hero's base tuft is denser and reaches higher between the lower blooms; at 1k triangles the tuft is thinner and shows some stem.
Petals are 8 wide strips per bloom rather than the hero's ~20 thin ragged ones, so skirts read as faceted umbrellas up close.

Material names are Flower_Petal_Pink and Flower_Seed_Orange (the AD's Petal_Pink / Seed_Orange with a Flower_ prefix) because the game only gives the plant shading role and season recolouring to names containing leaf/needle/grass/stem/flower; 'Petal' or 'Seed' alone fall back to timber.
IoU moves about +-0.02 with the random seed alone (leaf placement); seed 11 was kept.

rights: Original work for Abbie's World. Concept art generated on Evan's Midjourney account; geometry generated procedurally, no third-party meshes or textures.
